title: Revise the personal access goal to cover channels and data rights
requirements:
- Qualify the rights statement as subject to applicable law
- Describe patient-empowered, decentralised control of information sharing as a complement to central management
- Describe the wallet as one option alongside portals, printed documents and assisted access
- Add a short explanation under the figure of how registry, LHR, terminology, LIMR, consent and trust work together
- Add an assessment question on who can actually use the infrastructure and through which channels
- Map alternative access channels, including assisted, proxy and non-digital access
- Reflect self-managed care and prevention, including long-term care at home
- Add assisted, delegated and non-digital access pathways
